about:
Challenge Electronics, Inc. was established in 1991 in East Providence, Rhode Island. The company operates as a full-service electronics center from its location at 900 Waterman Avenue, serving both business and personal electronics needs.

The firm specializes in two-way communications, marine electronics systems, GPS navigation, and satellite communications. Its team of sales and technical service specialists provides product selection, installation, and ongoing support for land mobile radio and marine equipment. The company also operates a sister firm focused on marine electronics.

Challenge Electronics serves customers in the two-way radio, marine electronics, and specialty electronics sectors. Its client base includes commercial fleets, public safety agencies, and recreational boaters seeking communication and navigation solutions. The company represents brands such as Motorola, as indicated by its authorized use of Motorola trademarks.

The company emphasizes total customer satisfaction and positions itself as a leading resource for land mobile communications and marine systems, drawing on over three decades of experience since its founding.
